name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Success & Technical Support | Account Ownership, Issue Diagnosis, Training & AI-Assisted Support
summary: Client success specialist who owns a client's problem until they say it's fixed. Retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye, onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix, and trains less technical users until they're confident on their own. Technically hands-on: works in HTML, CSS, and JSON, traces integration errors, and configures and evaluates AI-generated responses against written standards, the same work as tuning an AI support agent. Came to SaaS after 15+ years in restaurant kitchens, where taking care of people is the whole job.

experience.title: Client Success & Implementation (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Own every client relationship end to end, from discovery and onboarding through day-to-day support, keeping a written record of every interaction, open item, and deliverable in HubSpot, GoHighLevel, and Notion.
Diagnose and fix broken workflows and integrations across client websites, CRMs, and automation tools, reading error output and JSON payloads to find where a problem lives before changing anything.
Configure and evaluate AI-generated responses for client automation systems, scoring output against rubric-based criteria and rewriting the instructions behind it when it misses.
Write and publish educational guides on CRM and systems setup, and build reusable templates so recurring questions get a documented answer.
Spot services clients aren't using yet and recommend them where they fit the client's goals, expanding retainer scope.
Build and maintain client websites in HTML/CSS with Google Tag Manager and GA4 tracking.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder client accounts, resolving client feedback quickly to protect satisfaction and retention, and delivered recurring performance reviews (QBRs).

experience.title: Customer Success & Retention (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Onboarded and supported 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94%) through the full tenure.
Used partner utilization and performance data to spot accounts not getting full value, then stepped in with recovery plans that reduced churn.
Guided clients through complex technical setup of listings, reputation, and marketing automation tools, and built automated training sequences that cut onboarding friction.
Fed structured, prioritized client issues and feedback to Product and Engineering to inform fixes and the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, aiming to get each one live on the first call and building multi-session plans for complex builds; held 110% of implementation targets.
Trained and coached onboarding teams of up to 30 through weekly sessions, 1:1 coaching, and workshops whenever a new initiative rolled out.
Walked small-business owners through website, e-commerce, and Google Business Profile setup, contributing to a 25% improvement in conversion rates across supported accounts.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran workshops for client teams on how each part of the platform fit their workflow, and troubleshot workflow design and technical setup alongside the implementation team.
Escalated risks to leadership early and built Zapier automations and API integrations for clients.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
